formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2 split entry: packet entries 'Aqua (Water' and 'Eau)' merged into one entry 'Aqua (Water, Eau)'; all positions below are normalized (raw packet position minus 1 from SLES onward).
formulaBlock.prominenceCutoff: E3: Parfum (Fragrance) at normalized 9; positions 1-8 prominent.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3); no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Single buffer; silicone/refatter load does not move the convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful silicone/cationic deposition system (early Dimethicone 7, Amodimethicone 11, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride 12) with light routes Hydrolyzed Keratin (6), PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (5), Glycol Distearate (14), Hydrogenated Castor Oil (13), Apricot Kernel Oil (20). C2 NOT met: no deliberate humectant route (none of Glycerin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium PCA, Urea, Sorbitol, Betaine; Propylene Glycol does not count, R11). No W-RICH (no prominent payload lipid).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The other three C2 elements are present (early silicone, cationic polymer, pearlizing route); the missing humectant route is the counter-signal, so high is the neighbor (C2 R11).

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: a persistent silicone system (prominent Dimethicone 7 plus Amodimethicone 11) converges with cationic guar (12) and a prominent keratin film (6); reset is an ordinary buffered SLES chassis and there is no rich lipid architecture.

depositionLoad.rationale: Dimethicone prominent, amodimethicone and guar just after fragrance, keratin prominent; lipids trace.

persistence.rationale: Amodimethicone and dimethicone are substantive; hydrolyzed keratin light.

weightPotential.w1Check: W1 conditions (a) and (b) hold (C1 chassis with buffer; silicone + guar + late amodimethicone), but (c) fails: a prominent protein film, Hydrolyzed Keratin (6), reinforces the set. W1 not cited; full 6.6 method decides.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone/guar/amodimethicone plus keratin give noticeable bounded residue; ordinary reset and no W-RICH keep it short of heavy.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no prominent payload lipid (no W-RICH), the keratin is hydrolyzed and light, lipids are trace, and the SLES chassis is effective; not low: a prominent silicone plus amodimethicone and guar is a persistent depositing system (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Three converging deposition families including persistent silicones: high realistic (neighbor high).

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: repair_supported (Hydrolyzed Keratin 6 with a silicone/amodimethicone/guar deposition cluster); no humectant cluster for moisture.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met only via prominent PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (5) on the E4 humectant/refatting list; no comfort route.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Sodium Salicylate (28) is a preservative.
